model_v4.definition: v3 with every tile-dependent quantity read from the tile (scripts/r3_timing_model_v4.py docstring): c_time(tile) = c_card x c_counter(tile) / 344.1 and PHI(tile, g) = F(tile, g) / c_counter(tile); geometry, k-steps, grid, dead CTAs and bytes on the tile's geometry; occupancy from the census
model_v4.reduction_to_v3 (design-tile-review 1a): at R3's tile c_counter is 344.1 and c_scale exactly 1.0, PHI is v3's own CTA_FIXED_KSTEPS (1.512 / 2.846): `python scripts/r3_timing_model_v4.py --check` re-prices all 300 registered v3 predictions of rental6-skew and rental7-skew and requires equality with the registered numbers (6 decimals) and with rental 6's pricer bit for bit (tests/test_tile_v4.py runs it)

c_counter.mma.sync: 344.1 x MVA2(W_tile, BK, occ) / MVA2(W_R3, 64, occ_R3,g); W from the census PTX (R3's SEEN PTX gives 280)
c_counter.wgmma other: mva(D_accounting(tile), Z_wg, occ): Z_wg puts the 128x128 tile at c_128
c_counter.v4cal: the per-tile c and F measured on that tile's CAL pages (CAL-A), the fallback at 64x128

F_forms.F-step (registered, v3's own form): PHI in k-steps carries: PHI_wg,g = F_wg,g / c_128 at every wgmma tile; R3's PHI on the mma.sync path
F_forms.F-cyc (rival): F in cycles carries: PHI = F / c_counter(tile)
F_forms.selection_rule: F-step unless, on rental A's two 64x128 w8 pages (the joint fit's F_64,w1 and F_64,w2), F-cyc is nearer the measured F on BOTH GEMMs AND F-step misses it by more than 3 se on at least one (tcommon.f_form_rule); the two forms are equal at 128x128

eta_mma.source: Luo et al., 'Dissecting the NVIDIA Hopper Architecture through Microbenchmarking and Multiple Level Analysis', arXiv 2501.12084, Table 11: m64n256k16 dense SS random data, 583 TFLOPS at 1260 MHz on 114 SMs = 0.991 per clock; carried to m64n128k16 and m64n64k16 by Table 9's within-table random-data ratios 659.8 / 665.4 and 648.3 / 665.4
eta_mma.why_per_clock (build-tile-review 1): v4 counts MMA cycles at a held lock (A2: L, 1410 MHz), so eta is a per-clock efficiency; Table 11 is the only wgmma rate with its clock recorded (1260 MHz, nearer 1410 than 1710 is)
eta_mma.what_it_is: MEASURED ON AN H800 PCIe (114 SMs, 350 W cap) WITH FP16 INPUTS; Luo attribute the random-data drop of Table 9 to the power cap lowering the clock
eta_mma.assumption: REGISTERED ASSUMPTION: BF16 on the GH200 runs at the same per-clock rate as FP16 on the H800 PCIe; untested here

rival.source: Luo et al. Table 9: 659.8 (N 128) and 648.3 (N 64) of the 756.5 TFLOPS chip peak at the 1620 MHz whitepaper clock (chip-relative, the power-capped clock folded in)
rival.status: printed beside every accounting; NOT SEPARATED on rental B by construction (0 lever cells)

sensitivity (build-tile-review 1).selection_effect: the 3% accounting band is DESCRIPTIVE, but its selection decides whether rental B derives c_64 or takes v4cal (D3). Where the eta choice moves c_64 by more than 3% (the cases listed) it can change WHICH accounting holds on rental A's 64x128 pages, so the selection is read under the registered (per-clock) rate only; under v4cal the eta effect on rental B is 0

eta_smem.status: UNTESTED REUSE: MVA2's eta, fitted on mma.sync LSU wavefronts (rental 4, SEEN-fitted), divides shared bytes on the wgmma path too

accountings.B: wgmma operand reads plus cp.async writes, both at 128 B/clk/SM on one port
accountings.W: operand reads at 128 B/clk/SM, cp.async writes as LDGSTS wavefronts (1 per 512 B)

calibration (CAL-A).pages: f128: OLMoE and Mixtral 8x7B, 128x128x64 w8 s3, G 64 counter pages, treads 1..9 (R3's counter ladder)
calibration (CAL-A).estimator: tcommon.joint_cF: sm__cycles_elapsed.avg = a(page model, GEMM, arm) + ceil(N_live / 132) (S_g c + F_g), one c for both GEMMs and both models, F_w1 and F_w2, by least squares over the NATIVE and SHARED cells at n 4..9 whose GEMM reads DRAM at no more than 0.5 x 4022 GB/s (each cell's own GEMM's dram_bytes_read over its gpu_time_ns, design-tile-review 9.4); OLMoE S 32 / 16 and Mixtral S 64 / 224 give four depths
calibration (CAL-A).outputs: c_128, F_wg,w1, F_wg,w2 (3 CAL-A constants), then Z_wg per accounting at the census occupancy (r3_timing_model_v4.z_wg); an accounting whose pipe alone exceeds c_128 is FALSIFIED by construction
calibration (CAL-A).refusal: fewer than 6 floor-bound cells or a rank-deficient design: NOT SCORED, and rental B does not run (no v4)

test (BLIND-CALMODEL, DESCRIPTIVE).pages: f64w8: OLMoE and Mixtral 8x7B at 64x128x64 w8 s3, G 64; f64w4 (drop-group w4): OLMoE at w4, printed
test (BLIND-CALMODEL, DESCRIPTIVE).statistic: per (model, GEMM): u = S c + F; u_meas from the 64x128 joint fit (same estimator), u_pred from each accounting's c_64 and the registered F form; e = u_pred / u_meas - 1
test (BLIND-CALMODEL, DESCRIPTIVE).rule: an accounting HOLDS when every |e| <= 3% (design-tile-review 9.4: within 3% of u, on the floor-bound n 4..9 cells of each page)
test (BLIND-CALMODEL, DESCRIPTIVE).status: DESCRIPTIVE (design-tile-review 1c): the accounting reading has no consequence for E1-TILE; B, W and T move rental B's predictions by at most 1.761569% at the nominal constants
test (BLIND-CALMODEL, DESCRIPTIVE).w4: the w4 page is printed only (w8 and w4 issue different instructions and their per-iteration delay may differ, so T's w8 / w4 = 1.00 is not a hard prediction); when dropped nothing changes
test (BLIND-CALMODEL, DESCRIPTIVE).mma_sync_32x128_w4: MVA2 on the census wavefronts at 32x128x64 w4 s3: HOLDS / FAILS within 3% of the page's c, printed for D1 (the decode tiles' only floor evidence); MVA2 is SEEN-fitted (D5)

scorer_ambiguities.1 which c is the denominator, and F's un: c_time = c_card x c_counter(tile) / 344.1 (344.1 the CAL counters' c); F is held in counter cycles and PHI = F / c_counter(tile) in k-steps; at R3's tile v4 is v3 exactly (r3_timing_model_v4.py --check)
scorer_ambiguities.2 F-cyc against F-step: F-step (v3's form) is registered; F-cyc replaces it only when, on the 64x128 w8 pages, it is nearer the measured F on both GEMMs and F-step misses by more than 3 se on one (tcommon.f_form_rule)
scorer_ambiguities.3 eta_mma: per clock (Luo Table 11, 0.991), per instruction by Table 9's ratios: 0.983 (m64n128k16, 128x128 w8), 0.965 (m64n64k16, 64x128); H800 PCIe, FP16; BF16 on GH200 assumed equal; rival Table 9's chip-relative 0.872 / 0.857
scorer_ambiguities.4 tA-floor: the test statistic is u = S c + F per (model, GEMM), within 3%; cells are the NATIVE and SHARED cells at n 4..9 whose own GEMM reads DRAM at no more than 0.5 x 4022 GB/s; a dropped w4 page changes nothing (printed only); at 128x128 v4cal and v4 are the same model
scorer_ambiguities.5 the NAMED rule's rows, and the default: every scored w1 row of the G-1 byte pages (uniform, balanced and skewed, NATIVE and SHARED); nothing NAMED gives CLAMP, not v3
scorer_ambiguities.6 E1-TILE's 'each model': the three BLIND-TILE models; deepseek-v2-lite is in the pooled bar only (its own bar DESCRIPTIVE, never CERTIFIED); a model left with one page is scored and NOT CERTIFIED
scorer_ambiguities.7 the host cut: 0.40 ms (T + F240), rental 3's registered rule, on the FINALISED v4 prediction
scorer_ambiguities.8 tA-rep dropped: rental 3's 0.18% feeds the rivals' se, tA-dead's z and the power at finalisation
scorer_ambiguities.9 tA-e1cal 'fails': on the CLEAN view: the pooled NATIVE bar, each class mean within 0.75%, the 128 G 1 CAL models within 1%; a SKIPPED, LOST or NOT SCORED E1-CAL page, or a G3 void, is a STOP (tileB-stop)
scorer_ambiguities.10 the OLS rival: one ridge OLS over every valid NATIVE E1-CAL cell (features waves, bytes / bw, ln(1 + CTAs); lambda 1e-3 x trace(X'X) / 3 on standardised features); NOT SCORED under 12 cells or condition number over 1e6
scorer_ambiguities.11 census against counter occupancy: integers, exact; a counter page at another occupancy is scored at its recorded one (rental 4's re-key, score_floor: Z_wg at the 128x128 pages' recorded occupancy, each 64x128 page's c at its own); on rental B a (model, tile) at another occupancy than rental A's census is NOT SCORED on every page of that (model, tile), and a missing or refused rental-B census leaves every page NOT SCORED (score_tileB.census_check); a refused rental-A census is a STOP
scorer_ambiguities.12 tA-dead: tread n 1 (uniform and balanced); align growth = (A_S - A_N) at c15 minus at c9 off each page's align_probe; se = 2 sigma_page mean(T) / sqrt(cells), sigma_page tA-rep's or 0.18%
scorer_ambiguities.13 the 30 MiB row key: one of the card's two L2 partitions of its measured 60 MiB (rental 4's rulers, CONSISTENT with RRZE's GH200; Hopper's partitioned L2, NVIDIA H100 whitepaper); the 'Fan et al.' attribution is withdrawn
scorer_ambiguities.14 byte pages and timed pages: one histogram file per (model, tile, G): a byte page and a timed page of the same (model, tile, G) read the same file, so their counts are identical (the files' sha256 above)

lock.decision (owner, 2026-10-20): a 900 W GPU power limit (GPU scope, -sc 0) and the lock ladder 1710, 1410, 1305 MHz: the probe tries 1710 first; the first rung whose probe passes is the run's lock
lock.changes: the owner's 2026-09-26 decision (the GPU power limit 700 W at the start, -sc 0) FOR TILE RENTAL A2 AND RENTAL B2 ONLY (B2 runs at the limit and the lock rung A2 held, read from A2's score directory); every other rental's driver keeps 700 W
lock.why (DESIGN-A2 1, REVIEW-A2 1): rental A's wgmma pages sagged under the 1710 lock: reason 0x4 (SW power cap) only, 60 C at most; the smi trace went to 1290 MHz on the three heavy 128x128 pages; the inferred cause is the software power cap (GPU or module scope unresolved), so the limit rises to the card's maximum and the lock steps down only when the probe says the cap still bites
lock.ladder (owner, 2026-10-20): 1710, then 1410, then 1305 MHz: the lock-hold probe's first rung that holds is A2's lock (tileA2-gates G-PROBE). At 1710 no clock conversion is used (v4L is v4 exactly) and CONV-L does not run; 1410 and 1305 carry the conversion
